lesson.child_mission: Measuring with a ruler or tape means aligning the zero mark with one end and reading the scale at the other end without gaps or overlaps.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
A pencil starts at 0 and ends at 14.5 on a centimetre ruler. What length? What error if someone started at 1?

FEEDBACK
14.5 cm; starting at 1 would under-read by about 1 cm.

WATCH FOR
Measuring from the metal tip end if zero is not there, or leaving a gap, changes the length.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Measure six objects with a ruler or tape. Photograph or sketch the alignment for two. Write one common measuring error and how to avoid it.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

Parent: Written model 2: Common error: Measuring from the metal tip end if zero is not there, or leaving a gap, changes the length. Correction: 14.5 cm; starting at 1 would under-read by about 1 cm. Why: the correction restores accurate use of ruler.

Parent: Likely misconception: Measuring from the metal tip end if zero is not there, or leaving a gap, changes the length. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Place zero at the end of a ribbon. If the other end meets 18, the length is 18 cm. Starting at 1 by mistake makes the reading 1 cm too short.

TRY FIRST
A pencil starts at 0 and ends at 14.5 on a centimetre ruler. What length? What error if someone started at 1?

FEEDBACK
14.5 cm; starting at 1 would under-read by about 1 cm.
teach_steps.explain:
Measuring with a ruler or tape means aligning the zero mark with one end and reading the scale at the other end without gaps or overlaps.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
teach_steps.notice: Measuring from the metal tip end if zero is not there, or leaving a gap, changes the length. Correct the value or method, not just the appearance of the digits.
